t: Near Old Street tube station, a wall once held Banksy's Pulp Fiction. The stencil showed the characters played by Samuel L. Jackson and John Travolta in the 1994 film, with their guns swapped for bananas. It stayed on this wall from 2002 to 2007. Banksy is the anonymous street artist famous for stencils and dark humour, and prints of this image have since become valuable. One sold for ten thousand six hundred pounds in 2012, and a signed print fetched a hundred and twenty-five thousand in 2020.
